purpose: Agent-authored development fixture; invented policies, not actual store policies or independent accuracy evidence. No model tuning against results.

documents.text: Customers may return unworn clothing within thirty days of purchase. A purchase receipt and the original tags are required for a refund.
To track a shipped order, look up its tracking reference with the carrier. The shipment status and estimated delivery date are shown on the order page.
When available inventory falls below the reorder point, review a replenishment purchase. Consider supplier lead time, forecast demand and safety stock before choosing an order quantity.
A promotional discount can apply only during its start and end dates. The item must be promotion eligible, have available stock and satisfy the minimum profit margin.
For a damaged or defective product, collect a photograph of the defect and the order identifier. Send the case for human support review before deciding replacement eligibility.
The store opens at nine in the morning and closes at five in the evening from Monday to Friday. It is closed on Sunday.
For store pickup, bring the order confirmation and photo identification to the collection counter. Wait until the ready-for-collection notification before visiting.
A duplicate payment receipt can be requested using the order identifier and purchase date. Support verifies the purchase before sending a receipt. Never request a card PIN or password.
Size exchanges require unworn merchandise, original tags and a purchase receipt. The requested size must be available. If the size is unavailable, a support agent reviews alternatives.
A customer may request correction or deletion of account information through the privacy team. Identity verification is required before processing. Support must not disclose another customer account.
